sample_unit: synthetic cases (report drafts reviewed by 5 specialists)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of diagnostic conclusions across repeated generation from identical inputs
links.effect: 50 drafts generated from identical inputs produced stable diagnostic conclusions.
links.quote: Repeated generation from identical inputs (50 drafts) produced stable diagnostic conclusions, and all source-attributed statements cited correct sources, with 56 of 60 fully covered by the cited excerpt.

links.outcome: Specialist review of AI-generated report drafts for clinically meaningful errors
